subject: Exhibit service-lane plan, forklift window and sign print queue confirmation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.example>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.example>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.example>
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Exhibit service-lane plan, forklift window and sign print queue

Team —

We need to lock a few operational items for CloudCon build day before I sign off on the final floorplan:

1) Service-lane / forklift windows: Moscone has two forklift windows for hall B that allow pallet drops. We need a confirmed 2-hour window for crate unload and a staged forklift escort if we go >500 lbs on any pallet. Can Logan confirm crate weights and whether the A/V rack needs forklift access?

2) Print queue for 36" backwall vinyl + 6x PVC placards: PrintWorks says they can do same-week but we need final art and a pickup slot at the loading dock. I attached the draft artwork as artwork_sign_pack_v4.pdf — do not change layout without telling PrintWorks.

3) Insurance + exhibitor portal: Moscone requires proof of insurance at time of move-in; Marissa, can you attach the COI? The exhibitor portal also needs booth contractor creds uploaded (link in related_links).

Asks:
- Logan: confirm crate/pallet weights and whether forklift is required by EOD Thursday (23rd).
- Marissa: upload proof_of_insurance.pdf to the portal and confirm pickup window preference for PrintWorks (morning vs. afternoon).
- Tessa/Stephanie: any guest experience constraints on sign placement? We have one large printed header that might conflict with sightlines.

I will follow up with Samantha at Moscone once we have the weights + COI.

Thanks —

Irene Choi
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.example
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: exhibit_floorplan_v2.pdf (floorplan, vendor notes)
Attachment: artwork_sign_pack_v4.pdf (sign art, proofs)

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@westcon-events.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: Moscone Exhibitor Services <exhibitor@moscone.example>
Date: Thu, 23 Nov 2028 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exhibit service-lane plan, forklift window and sign print queue

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the heads up. A few clarifications from exhibitor services:

- Forklift windows are allocated first-come-first-serve. To secure a 2-hr slot for November 28 move-in, we need weight manifests and vehicle ETA by 11/24 17:00 PT. Escort fee applies for loads > 1,000 lbs.

- Drive-in clearance: the hall B dock has a 12' vertical clearance; confirm the tallest crate dimension.

- Print pickup: vendors must select a dock pickup window; morning (07:00–10:00) slots are limited on move-in day. Use the exhibitor portal (https://exhibitor.moscone.example/portal/CloudCon-2028-12345) to request; we will confirm within 24 hours.

If you want, I can tentatively hold a morning slot pending your manifest. Also, please email the COI to exhibitor@moscone.example when ready.

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Senior Logistics Coordinator — Moscone Exhibitor Services
Samantha.Ruiz@westcon-events.com
+1 (415) 555-3011

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.example>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.example>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exhibit service-lane plan, forklift window and sign print queue

Hi all —

Quick update:

- Logan confirmed the crate manifest: two crates at 720 lbs each (main AV rack) and three smaller crates under 200 lbs. Forklift required for the two 720 lb crates only; dimensions attached below.

- I uploaded the COI to the exhibitor portal (file: proof_of_insurance.pdf) and emailed a copy to exhibitor@moscone.example as requested.

- PrintWorks: prefer a morning pickup slot (07:00–09:00) on Nov 28 so the team can stage signs at the dock before the pallet unload. Please confirm if you can hold that window; if not, confirm an afternoon alternative.

- Sightlines: Tessa, Stephanie — the 36" backwall header will be 8' tall and centered on the island. We pushed the header back 6" in the floorplan to avoid obstructing adjacent demo sightlines (see exhibit_floorplan_v2.pdf).

Next steps: once PrintWorks confirms morning pickup, Samantha — please tentatively reserve a 2-hr forklift window 07:30–09:30 and note the two 720 lb crates requiring escort.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.example
+1 (415) 555-0273

Attachment: crate_dimensions_spec.pdf (dimensions for two heavy crates)

From: Ops Team <ops@printworks.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.example>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.example>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.example>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exhibit service-lane plan, forklift window and sign print queue

Hi Marissa / Irene —

PrintWorks confirms the morning pickup slot for Nov 28: 07:15–08:45 (dock window A3). We will have a two-person crew and a pallet jack; forklift will be on standby per your note. Art proofs attached (artwork_sign_pack_v4_proof.pdf).

We also uploaded the pickup authorization to the Moscone portal and marked your contact as Marissa Cole for on-site release. Please have a printed copy of the COI available at the dock for the exhibitor services team.

We will deliver the 36" backwall vinyl on a single skid (wrapped) and the 6 PVC placards in separate flat crates. ETA to the dock: 07:30; handoff to your rigging crew at 07:45.

If anything changes overnight, reply-all and we will adjust.

Cheers,
PrintWorks Studio — Operations
ops@printworks.example
+1 (888) 555-4480
